title.narrative: K&I for Peace, Security and Justice

description.narrative: Within Peace, Security, and Justice (PSJ) Cordaid is dedicated to enhancing security and justice systems in fragile and conflict-affected settings (FCAS) through innovative, evidence-based approaches. This proposal for the Knowledge & Innovation Fund aims to strengthen Cordaid’s internal capacities, refine our programming methodologies across the cycle (from conceptualization/design to implementational & learning), and solidify our positioning with donors and external stakeholders.
